svg.title: Bays: commanded transitions, classification and rebalancing
svg.desc: Bay transitions the scheduler commands, ClassifyBay() rules from bay_rebalancing.cpp, and a worked example of ComputeBayRebalancingActions().
svg.metadata: ["The three bay commands the scheduler issues: TRANSITION_TO_RETRIEVE (from READY_TO_INSERT or VEHICLE_INSERTED), TRANSITION_TO_INSERT (from READY_TO_RETRIEVE) and PROCESS_RETRIEVE. The other states are reached through bay or customer activity.", "ClassifyBays() turns each bay's state, plus whether a tray and a payload sit in it, into a classification. A disabled bay, or a payload without a tray, is NOT_USABLE; a bay that is processing is INSERT_IN_PROGRESS or RETRIEVE_IN_PROGRESS.", "Worked example: four bays in bay_prioritization order [1, 2, 3, 4]. Classified, bays 1 and 4 are RETRIEVE_READY (no tray) and bays 2 and 3 are INSERT_READY (empty tray, no car). None is NOT_USABLE.", "CalculateDesiredBaySplit(): 4 eligible bays x target_insert_ready_bay_fraction 0.75, rounded up = 3 insert-ready bays wanted, capped by the 3 empty trays; the remaining 1 bay should be retrieve-ready.", "Loop 1: a RETRIEVE_IN_PROGRESS bay counts as insert-ready (the finished retrieve leaves it ready to insert) and is never changed. None here, so the counts stay at 3 and 1. (An INSERT_IN_PROGRESS bay is not counted.)", "Loop 2: walk bay_prioritization front to back and keep every bay that is already INSERT_READY until enough are found: bays 2 and 3 are kept, 1 insert-ready bay is still missing.", "Loop 3: walk the list back to front and keep bays that are already RETRIEVE_READY: bay 4 is kept, so the retrieve-ready quota is met.", "Loop 4: walk front to back again and pick bays to switch to insert. Bay 1 is RETRIEVE_READY and not kept, so it goes on the to-insert list; ExpandRebalanceGarageJob will run the READY_FOR_INSERT recipe (empty tray in, then TRANSITION_TO_INSERT).", "Loop 5 (switch to retrieve, back to front) has nothing left to do, and loop 6 finds no bay left that NEEDS_EMPTY_TRAY / NEEDS_TRAY_REMOVAL (those would fall back to retrieve-ready). Result: to-insert [1], to-retrieve [], a single bay transition. Keeping correct bays (loops 2, 3) before changing any (loops 4, 5) keeps transitions few."]
